class InvoiceException implements Exception {
  InvoiceException(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => 'InvoiceException: $message';
}

class InvoiceService {
  int total(List<int> lines) {
    if (lines.isEmpty) {
      throw InvoiceException('Fatura satırı yok');
    }
    return lines.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
  }
}

@pragma('vm:never-inline')
int computeTotals(InvoiceService s) => s.total(<int>[]);

void main() {
  try {
    computeTotals(InvoiceService());
  } catch (e, st) {
    print(e.runtimeType);
    print(st);
  }
}
